title: BigQuery: Secure Query Context, Native Parquet Geography Export, and a Breaking Change
summary: BigQuery introduces a new `secureContext` for passing sensitive, context-specific information to queries, accessible via a new SQL function. Additionally, you can now export Parquet data with native Geography types. Heads up: `JobStatistics2.referencedLogicalViews` is now read-only, which may break existing integrations.
details:
The `JobConfigurationQuery` and `QueryRequest` schemas now include a new `secureContext` field. This field, backed by the new `SecureContext` schema, allows developers to pass key-value pairs of sensitive or context-specific information directly into query execution. These values can then be retrieved within the query using the `SECURE_CONTEXT()` function, enabling more dynamic and secure query behaviors.

For data export, `JobConfigurationExtract` gains a `nativeGeographyExportEnabled` boolean property. When set to `true` for Parquet exports, BigQuery will now write the native Parquet Geography type instead of the default GeoParquet type, offering more control over geospatial data representation.

Breaking Change Alert: The `referencedLogicalViews` property within the `JobStatistics2` schema has been made read-only. If your applications or tools were previously attempting to set or modify this field, they will now encounter errors. Please update your code to reflect this change.
